The '''Chandrila Imperial garrison''', also known as the '''Hanna City Imperial Garrison''', was an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Garrison/Legends|garrison]] located near [[Hanna City/Legends|Hanna City]]. It was commanded by [[Major General]] [[Kalnor]].<ref name="Strongholds">''[[Strongholds of Resistance]]''</ref>

During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the garrison was surrounded by an electric fence and a group of [[All Terrain Armored Transport/Legends|AT-ATs]]. It was also used by [[Governor/Legends|Governor]] [[Gerald Weizel]] as his base. After the end of the war, the building was abandoned but not destroyed.<ref name="CatCW" />
